name: search_plays
description: Search the coach's saved playbook. Matches the query against play names, formation names and the original play calls. Returns up to 20 plays as id, name, formation and variants (label + source call). Use the returned id with show_play; never read ids aloud.

q.description: Short search text taken from what the coach said, e.g. a concept or formation name such as 'smash' or 'spread'. At most 100 characters.
